import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
m = int(data[1])
videos = list(map(int, data[2:]))

videos.sort(reverse=True)

current_time = 0
for size in videos:
    if size <= m:
        current_time += size
        m -= size
    else:
        current_time += m + size
        m = 0

import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])

videos = list(map(int, data[2:]))

videos.sort(reverse=True)

        m -= size
